title: Mexican Paella Casserole
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this Mexican paella casserole combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the spices of Mexico.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili peppers, cumin, and smoked paprika. Cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the paella rice and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
